title: The Coin in the Soil
lines: Nick is a boy who likes to dig.
He had a small toy shovel from Gran.
He wanted to plant seeds in the soil.
But the soil was hard and dry as rock.
The toy shovel would not go in at all.
Nick got a pail of water for the soil.
Then the soil was soft. He dug again.
His toy shovel tapped a hard, flat thing.
It was a coin, black with mud.
Nick made a happy noise. "Rosa! Come see!"
Rosa ran up the hill to join him.
They dug up a tin box of coins!
Mom will boil water to get the mud off.
Nick will keep one coin in his toy box.

questions.ask: Why would the toy shovel not go into the soil?
questions.listenFor: The soil was hard and dry as rock. Have them find that line.

questions.ask: What did Nick do to make the soil soft?
questions.listenFor: He got a pail of water and put it on the soil.

questions.ask: What would you do with a box of old coins? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. Listen for a reason of their own.
